category_specific_evidence: Reproducer in PR#10013: fdrcorrection([]) returns (array([], dtype=bool), array([], dtype=float64)) while multipletests([]) raises ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero.
The failure comes from computing alphacSidak and alphacBonf via 1 / ntests (1.0 / ntests and alphaf / float(ntests)) with ntests = 0 before method dispatch.
The fix guards the corrected-alpha computation with ntests > 0 and sets alphacSidak and alphacBonf to np.nan when there are no tests; per-method branches then run on the empty array.
Regression test test_multipletests_empty asserts reject and pvals_corrected have shape (0,) for every method and that the corrected alphas are NaN (np.isnan).
The commit message states unrecognised method names still raise as before.
